# E0513: `resume` outside a handler's operation

`resume` stands only in an operation of a handler written `handler Name -> R`, which takes control. An operation of any other handler gives its value, which resumes the code.

- Rule: [`handlers.resume-outside-operation`](../../reference/12-effects.md#handlers.resume-outside-operation)
- Reported at: the `resume`.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0513:6
effect Ask {
  fn ask() -> i64
}

fn answer() -> i64 {
  let h = handler Ask { fn ask() -> i64 { resume(1) } }
  with h { Ask.ask() }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
effect Ask {
  fn ask() -> i64
}

fn answer() -> i64 {
  let h = handler Ask { fn ask() -> i64 { 1 } }
  with h { Ask.ask() }
}
```
